questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: 100 level courses were quite easy. 300 level more difficult, but still very manageable

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Lectures were very much the same. Exercises more easy and more help from teachers

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Antarctica: The Cold Continent 
Environmental Processes: Principles and Applications 
Coastal Studies
Te Ara o Tawhaki: Maori Thought, Beliefs and Practices

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
The Maori course was a little difficult, since they kind of expected that you were from NZ and had some basic knowledge about the culture. However, I am very glad now that I took the course because it did give me a lot of insight in the Maori culture that I could not have received on my own. 

Will also recommend an Antarctica course - you will probably never be in an Antarctica gateway city again. The knowledge about Antarctica in NZ is quite unique.
